actual_prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one cinematic16:9 storyboard still.
Closer astronomical view isolating a sector of the same planetary system, selected cool pale-green planetary point at exact centre against sparse stars. Warm parent starlight spills weakly from beyond left edge; a narrow dusty plane runs obliquely across frame. Other objects sparse and far apart. No central glowing sun, no orbit-line diagram. Keep the target at exact image centre. No captions, arrows, orbit lines, frame border or reticle; optical views use sparse natural stars.

DEPARTURE SEQUENCE LOCK: Cinematic painted graphic-novel space adventure, fine controlled ink contours, detailed illustrated materials, deep indigo space, cyan practical lights and restrained warm amber edges. Adult Harper has established freckled face, hazel-green eyes and short curly auburn hair. She wears the same pod-issued warm-gray long-sleeved survival coverall, gathered cuffs, plain closed collar and fastening, gray belt, loose trousers and graphite utility shoes; tiny unlettered amber arm tab. Reference short-sleeved clothing is superseded. Personal ship is the established transparent spherical technological field, faint cyan geodesic grid, graphite equatorial band, upper/lower circular platforms, amber rim lights, sparse cyan rectangular lamps and one vertical open aft engine ring with cyan inner arc. Cabin is the established open spherical volume with curved graphite rail/platform and sparse floating holographic controls, not a conventional airplane cockpit. The newly discovered remote planet has a broad dark-emerald jungle continent, copper-coloured inland seas and ivory storm systems, visibly distinct from the opening turquoise/peach world. Only include subjects required by the specific shot. One uninterrupted full-frame cinematic16:9 image, quiet bottom strip for later lyrics; no captions, readable words, watermarks, panels or collage.

SCENE-SPECIFIC SUBJECT EXCLUSIONS, HIGHEST PRIORITY: This is a clean astronomical optical view containing ONLY the natural celestial objects explicitly required by this shot and sparse deep-indigo space. Absolutely no Harper, people, hands, cabin, ship, station, geodesic grid, hologram, UI, reticle or foreground object. Character/vehicle descriptions in the shared sequence lock are inactive continuity background and must NOT appear. Maintain the scale of the selected target requested above; do not enlarge it into a hero planet portrait.
Precise framing: selected target is at 50% image width AND 50% image height, where horizontal and vertical midlines intersect; not above the vertical centre. Target has a tiny unresolved green disc about 1% of frame height, substantially smaller than a hero planet.

PRECISE SCALE CORRECTION: Edit the supplied optical view only to shrink the central green target to ONE QUARTER of its current diameter, keeping its centre in exactly the same position. The target must be an unresolved green dot only about 1% of total image height: around 9 pixels if the image is 941 pixels high. Do not enlarge it to show surface detail. Retain the surrounding dusty sector and left-edge starlight. The tiny dot is intentionally barely visible; the next optical magnifications reveal it. All scene-specific exclusions above remain mandatory.

qa.notes: Central tiny green point with oblique dust plane, offscreen starlight left, no ship/UI. Corrected initial overly resolved globe; target now visually smaller than1% frame height and centred.
